title: 第十三章 黑粉跪地磕头求救，你对所有人都这样吗？
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
傅烬川摇了摇头，他最讨厌别人说他天煞孤星，更别说信命，父母的死总有一天会弄清楚。

    可他真的不信吗？遇到她，有些事情好像让人不得不信。

    脑海中莫名浮现出姜无念轻薄自己的模样，耳尖微微发烫，居然有点开始贪恋那种感觉。

    姜无念没有反驳他，只是忽然凑近，鼻尖几乎碰到他的侧脸。

    不信命的天煞孤星？真有意思，别人遇到这种命盘都急着去求神拜佛巴不得能改命，他竟然一点不在乎。

    傅烬川身体一僵，呼吸都慢了半拍，就见她眼底笑意更浓，“不信也没关系，反正你信我就行。”

    他别开脸，耳尖又悄悄泛红，强装镇定：“别胡闹。”

    “谁胡闹了？”姜无念轻“哼”一声，往他身边挤了挤，“你这当徒弟的，不帮师父揽客，像话吗？”

    傅烬川喉头有些梗塞，刚要开口反驳，想了想还是问出了压在心底许久的问题：“你……对所有人，都这样吗？”

    他实在是好奇，她总是这样主动亲近，是只对自己，还是对谁都如此。

    “哪样？”

    姜无念歪头装傻，她唇角含笑，趁他不注意，飞快在他脸颊亲了一下。

    “是这样吗？”

    软乎乎的触感一触即分，傅烬川的心跳瞬间漏跳了一拍。

    “咳咳咳……”

    他猛地抬头看向四周，发觉根本没人注意，才着急忙慌地往旁边挪了挪，耳尖更是一片通红。

    姜无念低低笑出声，掰着指头一本正经地数：“我亲过小白，阿茶，图图，吻狸……还有新来的大黄！”

    傅烬川听得眉头越皱越紧，心底莫名窜起一股涩意，语气沉了几分：“……这么多？”

    原来她对谁都一样，根本不是只对自己特别，这种被排除在外的感觉，让他很不舒服。

    “他们都跟我一样吗？”他声音闷闷的，心里的这种滋味，让人极度不适。

    姜无念一头雾水，她想了想，回答道：“一样？你指的什么？如果光说长相的话，那肯定不一样啊，它们都是我养的四脚灵兽。”

    “而你是两脚……兽。”

    傅烬川猛地抬头，撞上姜无念清澈的眸子，他有些犹豫：“灵……兽？”
content_en:
Fu Jinchuan shook his head. He hated it most when people said he was a lone star, let alone one who believed in fate. The death of his parents would be revealed one day.

    But does he really not believe it? When I meet her, there are some things that people cannot believe.

    The image of Jiang Wu Nian looking down on her appeared inexplicably in his mind, and the tips of his ears felt slightly hot, and he actually began to crave that feeling.

    Jiang Wunian did not refute him, but suddenly came closer, the tip of her nose almost touching the side of his face.

    The evil star who doesn’t believe in fate? It's really interesting that when other people encounter this kind of horoscope, they rush to pray to gods and Buddhas in the hope that they can change their lives, but he doesn't care at all.

    Fu Jinchuan's body stiffened and his breathing slowed down for half a beat. Then he saw the smile in her eyes getting stronger, "It doesn't matter if you don't believe me. Anyway, you just need to believe me."

    He turned his face away, the tips of his ears turned red again, and pretended to be calm: "Don't be ridiculous."

    "Who is fooling around?" Jiang Wu Nian snorted softly and squeezed closer to him, "As an apprentice, are you being honest if you don't help the master attract customers?"

    Fu Jinchuan's throat was a little clogged. He was about to retort, but after thinking about it, he asked the question that had been pressing in his heart for a long time: "Do you... treat everyone like this?"

    He was really curious whether she always took the initiative to get close to her like this, whether it was only to herself or to everyone.

    "What kind?"

    Jiang Wu Nian tilted her head and pretended to be stupid. With a smile on her lips, she quickly kissed his cheek while he wasn't paying attention.

    "Is that so?"

    The soft touch was instantaneous, and Fu Jinchuan's heart skipped a beat.

    "Cough cough cough..."

    He suddenly raised his head and looked around, realizing that no one was paying attention at all, so he hurriedly moved to the side, and the tips of his ears turned red.

    Jiang Wu Nian laughed softly and counted on his fingers seriously: "I've kissed Xiao Bai, Ah Cha, Tu Tu, Kissing Civet... and the new Rhubarb!"

    Fu Jinchuan's brows wrinkled tighter and tighter as he heard this, and there was an inexplicable astringency in his heart. His tone became a little darker: "...so many?"

    It turned out that she was the same to everyone, not just special to herself at all. This feeling of being left out made him very uncomfortable.

    "Are they all the same as me?" His voice was muffled, and the feeling in his heart made people extremely uncomfortable.

    Jiang Wunian was confused. She thought for a while and replied: "The same? What do you mean? If we just talk about the appearance, it must be different. They are both four-legged spiritual beasts that I raised."

    "And you are a two-legged...beast."

    Fu Jinchuan raised his head suddenly and met Jiang Wunian's clear eyes. He hesitated: "Spirit... beast?"
title_en: Chapter 13: Anti-fans kneel down and kowtow to beg for help. Do you do this to everyone?
